items.title: Our Project Suncatcher prototype satellite is in orbit.

items.title: Turn your existing social assets into high-impact YouTube ads.
items.content: In this Ads Decoded episode, we discuss ad creative — and how it can make or break your YouTube campaigns.
items.contentSnippet: In this Ads Decoded episode, we discuss ad creative — and how it can make or break your YouTube campaigns.

summaries.zh: 本文探讨了广告创意在YouTube广告中的作用。节目强调利用现有社交资产制作高影响力的广告，并指出创意对广告效果至关重要。内容围绕如何通过创意提升广告效果展开。
summaries.en: This Ads Decoded episode focuses on ad creative for YouTube campaigns, emphasizing its critical role in success or failure. items.title: We’re introducing SynthID Bio, bringing our watermarking technology to synthetic biology.
items.content: Google DeepMind introduces SynthID Bio to watermark AI-designed proteins while maintaining biological function. Read the full research report here.
items.contentSnippet: Google DeepMind introduces SynthID Bio to watermark AI-designed proteins while maintaining biological function. Read the full research report here.

summaries.zh: 谷歌DeepMind推出SynthID Bio技术，将水印技术应用于合成生物学，用于标记AI设计的蛋白质，同时保持其生物功能。详细研究报告请参阅原文。
summaries.en: Google DeepMind introduces SynthID Bio, a new technology that applies watermarking to synthetic biology. The system embeds unique digital markers into AI-designed proteins, enabling their identification while preserving biological functionality. The innovation aims to enhance transparency and traceability in synthetic biology research. For further details, refer to the full research report.

items.title: Google Arts & Culture turns 15 — and gives its app a makeover
items.content: Explore art and culture with visual-first conversation search, a redesigned home feed, AI experiments and 27 new city guides in the Google Arts & Culture app.
items.contentSnippet: Explore art and culture with visual-first conversation search, a redesigned home feed, AI experiments and 27 new city guides in the Google Arts & Culture app.
